title: Stability-Constrained Approximation in Spline KANs: Exact Layer Balancing and Budget-Compatible Saturation
summary: Deep spline superposition networks face a tension between approximation order and stability across depth. We study approximation under a hard layerwise Lipschitz budget, and organise it around two quantities: the factorisation stability complexity of a given deep factorisation, and the budget-compatible approximation complexity of a discretisation operator.
